changesSince: 0.2.0 (2026-11-01, owner consult points 2, 4, 5 and icon-first map text): symbol area by recorded rooms (hollow = unknown); names near the middle of the view ranked by recorded rooms and price, with chain-brand logos (107 of 112 brands, SHA-256 checked); hover card and panel icon chips incl. terrain facts; terrain mode at hilly sites (3D ground × 1.5, hillshade, district fill hard-switch at 12.5); legend, status and district chips use symbols; data refreshed with 47_ROOM_RESOLUTION (rooms 1,033,157; unknown 79) and 48_LOGO_LIBRARY brand identities. 0.1.0: first release from the CityMETER Fitness demo 0.3.1 (montri-th/fitness @50ec2b6). rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · group · size · province · chain, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ
rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table (a building or station panel shows its own rows)

firstAha.ranking: เขต/อำเภอ by the measure (then the other measure, then name) inside the home province = the province holding the most of the measure among rows placed at district level; up to three and never every district holding the measure (N ≤ 3 → top N − 1); never cut through a tie; none left → spread
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {share}% ของ{ห้องพัก|ที่พัก}ใน{home}ที่ระบุ{เขต|อำเภอ}ได้ อยู่ใน {n} {เขต|อำเภอ}นี้
firstAha.numerator: Σ measure of the focused districts (matched membership)
firstAha.denominator: Σ measure of the home province’s rows that carry a district (rows placed only at province level stated apart)
firstAha.personality: rail: share of the measure within 500 m (straight line) of an operating CityMETER Transit station among the focus rows with a point vs the rest of the province’s placed rows with a point, both bases stated; hidden when neither side has any
firstAha.secondaryFinding: district(s) with the most of the measure outside the home province (every district tied); “มากกว่า{เขต}ใดใน{home}” when it exceeds the first focus district; hidden with a province filter and when the top is < 2
firstAha.defaultCamera: city preset, fitPitched over the focused districts
firstAha.action: ดูทุกพื้นที่ (?areas=all); เปรียบเทียบพื้นที่ (opens charts); district names are links

areas.name: เมืองภูเก็ต

outside.name: เมืองเชียงใหม่

fallbacks.spread: every district of the home province holds the same value → spread finding, the camera frames them
fallbacks.unplaced: no district can be ranked → the count and a table action

countingUnitContract.default: rooms recorded (Σ rooms_selected, ห้อง)
countingUnitContract.rule: one row = one row of 01_VENUES (source-listed record, operation not revalidated); unknown rooms counted apart, never 0; the alias row is out of every figure

metricContract.areas: Σ measure per เขต/อำเภอ (rooms → LI li.supply; records → LDS count)
metricContract.provinces: Σ measure per province frame (same family)
metricContract.eligibility: none — totals; ties are never cut (firstAha.ranking)
metricContract.combined: Σ focus ÷ the home province’s placed total (a share, numerator and denominator shown)
metricContract.notDrawn: no per-area or per-person ratio: recorded rooms are not a density or a market measure
metricContract.ramp: all 41 samples of the family LUT by rank among the measured nonzero values being read (js/scales.js#buildRamp; owner standing rule “Color scale ขอให้ใช้ 41 scales ตาม LDS เสมอ”); map, legend, labels, rank bars and the district chart read one ramp; the matrix has its own ramp over its cells

coverageContract.covered: every เขต/อำเภอ of the 77 provinces is in the register’s national scope

states.measured_zero: sample 0 + zero outline — no record of the dataset is placed there under the filters
states.no_data: rooms only: the district has records but none with known rooms (hatch)

coverageContract.unplaced: rows without a district are counted apart (province only, conflict), never shown as 0

apartment.th: อพาร์ตเมนต์และเซอร์วิสอพาร์ตเมนต์

guesthouse.th: เกสต์เฮาส์และโฮสเทล

other.th: ที่พักอื่น

categoricalCueContract.sizeCue: symbol area ∝ recorded rooms (radius = k(zoom)·√(rooms/100), cap 1,500, min 1.6 px; js/model.js#pinRadius); unknown rooms = open outline at the 50-room size; colour stays the group’s; quiet context ≤ 6 px radius

framesContract.index: data/area-index.json — 928 districts and 77 provinces, no geometry (codes, names, production areaSqm, label, bbox)
framesContract.frames: data/frames/{CODE}.json — district outlines per province (77 files)
framesContract.loading: the selection’s provinces at once; the provinces under the map at district zoom (≤ 6 per move); never all 77 up front; versioned with the release tag
framesContract.failure: reported and retried on the next request; panels, charts and table never depend on outlines

mapFocusContract.principle: detail only for the focused part — the selected district, the station, the hotel, the automatic or explicit focus; everything else visible but quiet

states.auto: default top districts; released when none of them is on screen

mapFocusContract.choropleth: li.supply (rooms) or count (records), 41-sample ramp by rank, under the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5; the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; measured_zero = sample 0 + 2 px zero outline; no_data = hatch

source.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the hotel point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

rail.drawn: operating stations as quiet rings from zoom 10.5 (names from 13.5), clickable → station panel; the open station’s 500 m radius dashed
rail.hotel: nearest operating station within 2 km and nearest station under construction (words only)

groups.mall: ศูนย์การค้า
groups.community: คอมมูนิตีมอลล์
groups.component: ส่วนค้าปลีกในโครงการ
groups.hoststore: ห้างและซูเปอร์มาร์เก็ต

source.rule: countable, located venues of the groups listed with status supply; straight-line distance from the hotel point to the venue reference point, up to 1500 m

retail.hotel: nearest venue within 1.5 km, linked to the same venue in CityMETER Shopping centers by id

contextContract.inBuilding: 16_BRANCH_SPATIAL_CANDIDATES qualified spatial_candidate_requires_identity_review: a branch of another CityMETER research dataset whose source point falls in the same research building mass; not a tenancy, floor or located-in claim
contextContract.distances: straight lines between reference points — never a walking route, travel time or catchment

compsetContract.around: every record within 2,000 m (any group) with rooms and unknown count

contextActionsContract.ai: Google AI Mode (udm=50) with a question written for the view
contextActionsContract.maps: Google Maps search by public names
contextActionsContract.streetView: only with a point (hotel point, station reference point “ใกล้สถานี”)
contextActionsContract.note: เปิดใน Google · ผลลัพธ์ไม่ใช่ข้อมูล CityMETER

buildingJoinContract.click: one hotel → the hotel; several → the building panel

interactionContract.keyboard: roving tabindex over HTML pins from zoom 15.5; roving tablist for chart views; arrow keys on the measure switch; visible focus everywhere

massingContract.cityTier: basemap building extrusions, quiet, faded with distance from the focus

presets.eye: pitch 75 · fov 24 (the building view: venue, building, hotel with a point)

buildingView.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “อาคารที่เลือก หรือ on focus ให้แสดงด้วยมุมมอง 2-point perspective เสมอ zoom to fit viewport เสมอด้วย”
buildingView.module: js/camera.js#fitBuilding, twoPointBearing, wallAzimuth, occlusionScore, screenBounds (from CityMETER · Shopping centers); js/app.js#frameFocus
buildingView.target: js/app.js#focusTarget — the open building; the building the open venue’s registry point falls in; the building the open hotel’s point falls in
buildingView.bearing: dominant wall azimuth + 45°, on the diagonal where the drawn focus buildings (massing.obstaclesNear, 400 m) hide least of it, then the one nearest the current bearing
buildingView.fit: eye preset, padding zero; fit points = the pieces as the focus tier draws them at building zoom (massing.fitPointsOf → js/massing.js#footprintFitPoints: the offset and fillets of zoom 18, ground and roof), never the shape drawn at the starting zoom (up to 3.6 m wider on every side); every one inside the free box (js/app.js#visibleBox: below the toolbar, above the Aha card, legend, chart tray, table or open phone sheet, left of the zoom control), one side filling 94% of it; maxZoom 21 when the building is known (js/camera.js#BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM — Hotel hotels stand in shophouses and small buildings; the Shopping centers limit 19.5 left a 40 m building at half the box) / 18 while unknown, minZoom 14
buildingView.unknown: a 90 m box round the point (12 m tall) framed the same way; the camera turns to the building when it arrives, at most twice, never after a user camera move
buildingView.plan: 3D off: the same footprint fitted flat (fitPitched plan, maxZoom 21 known / 18 unknown)

tileCoverGuard.bug: MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles checks the four children of a missing ideal tile whenever the cover zoom + 1 ≤ the source maxzoom; a pitched cover can already hold an ideal tile at the maxzoom, whose children() is ONE overscaled child; when that child is retained, children[1] is undefined and the frame throws “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'key')”
tileCoverGuard.seen: live 2026-10-29 (Claude desktop browser, real OpenFreeMap tiles): openmaptiles (vector, maxzoom 14), cover zoom 13, camera 13.79–13.95, pitch 75, while the building camera flew between branches; reproduced in the build container by stepping the pitched camera out from 19.5 to 13.6 over a building (7–8 errors on 0.2.0, 0 with the guard)
tileCoverGuard.fix: pad the child list of exactly those ideal tiles to four copies of the overscaled child, so the check reads as MapLibre's own overzoom branch; installed on the shared SourceCache prototype at every style load; only for version 5.6.2

venueXrayContract.module: js/venue-xray.js#installVenueXray(map, {beforeId, toMercator, colors}) → {update(features, {colors}), setEnabled, hitTest(point), dispose, count, enabled, failed} (from CityMETER · Shopping centers / Luxury Brands)
venueXrayContract.layer: venue-xray (custom, renderingMode 3d) before place-quarter (js/map-style.js#VENUE_XRAY_BEFORE): drawn over every building and over road names
venueXrayContract.input: the features of the building being looked at (massing.featuresOf(target.refs)) with display_height_m / display_base_m
venueXrayContract.depth: scissored depth clear inside the building’s screen box, then its own depth test
venueXrayContract.seeThrough: massing.setScene('eye', rings): the focus buildings standing in front of it turn see-through (SCENE.eye)
venueXrayContract.labels: district label chips never sit on the building (refreshLabelView avoid box)
venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only, zoom ≥ 13 (XRAY_MIN_ZOOM); empty outside the building view
venueXrayContract.colours: map.activeLayer faces, map.selectedStroke edges — map roles, not data colours
venueXrayContract.failSafe: a GL error disables it (failed = true); the massing highlight keeps drawing
venueXrayContract.geojsonMaxzoom: every GeoJSON source uses maxzoom 24 (js/map-layers.js#GEOJSON_MAXZOOM, the most geojson-vt allows), two levels above BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM: MapLibre 5.6.2 throws in SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles when the near tiles of a pitched cover reach a GeoJSON source maxzoom before they have data (seen in CityMETER · Shopping centers 2026-10-25); under the eye preset the near tiles sit up to about half a level above the camera (tests/release.test.js)

breadcrumbContract.provinceCodes: production route codes (base info lv0 abbrEn)

provinceContract.fill: the measure below zoom 8 without a province filter

pictogramContract.rule: decorative (aria-hidden); the text carries the meaning; no star

panel.provenance: exactly one line per view: dataset · source (+ Transit / Shopping centers when shown) · date · boundary, and the unit clause

visualSystem.themes: light and dark; analytical HEX identical on both
visualSystem.fonts: Bai Jamjuree · IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped · Arvo · JetBrains Mono (assets/lds/build-kit)

invariants.rule: unknown rooms are never 0 (counted apart; district no_data under rooms; chips read records)
recorded prices are per hotel only, “ราคาที่บันทึก”, period unknown; never summed or averaged across hotels
membership is the district matched at build time (row.admin); never re-assigned on screen

one symbol = one row with a point; never clustered

colours only from assets/theme.css, js/scales.js, js/cues.js; 41 samples by rank; same HEX on both themes
no address, phone, raw record, researcher text, private document link or Landometer commercial term in the repository
